head: lʕs (< MEA lʕs cf. SL 695: to chew; to dine;)

examples.translation: er hat keinen Eifer, den bisschen Brot zu kauen
examples.raw: lat-le ġira loʕəs u=fako d-laḥmo ʻer hat keinen Eifer, den bisschen Brot zu kauenʼ; 184; 77/46;

examples.turoyo: i=naqla d-ko-maḥto u=fako b-feme k-omər xwazi loʕsát-way-li-yo žnuka maḥtát-way-le b-femi
examples.translation: Every time she put a piece of bread into his mouth he would say: “Oh mother, if only you would chew it for me and then would put it into my mouth!”
examples.raw: i=naqla d-ko-maḥto u=fako b-feme k-omər xwazi loʕsát-way-li-yo žnuka maḥtát-way-le b-femi ʻEvery time she put a piece of bread into his mouth he would say: “Oh mother, if only you would chew it for me and then would put it into my mouth!” 184; 77/45;

examples.turoyo: u=muklo hēš meqəm d-məbləʕ k-məlʕəs b-aʕ=ʕarše
examples.translation: die Speise wird, ehe sie heruntergeschluckt wird, mit den Zähnen gekaut
examples.raw: u=muklo hēš meqəm d-məbləʕ k-məlʕəs b-aʕ=ʕarše ʻdie Speise wird, ehe sie heruntergeschluckt wird, mit den Zähnen gekautʼ; 184; 3/36;

notes: Dear Jan, what is the past-tense form of locəs 'kauen/chew'? lcəsle? lacəs? The past-tense is “lcësle” and “lcëswole” (for long time) [masculin] Lcësla, lcëswola [feminine]
